decks.notes: This aggro deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and flip Thing in the Ice. Chart a Course and Pieces of the Puzzle help dig for necessary spells, while Treasure Cruise provides additional card draw. Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse help deal with threats on the board, while Izzet Charm provides versatility. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Flame-Blessed Bolt offer additional power and reach. The deck's mana base is streamlined for consistency in casting spells and utilizing the powerful Hall of Storm Giants.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana to cast powerful green creatures and planeswalkers, while also generating devotion to green to enhance their abilities. With cards like Karn, the Great Creator, Nissa, Who Shakes the World, and Old-Growth Troll, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game. Additional support is provided by cards like Storm the Festival and Wolfwillow Haven to further accelerate the mana ramping process. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently utilizing green mana and aggressive plays to dominate the battlefield.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board through a combination of powerful planeswalkers, counterspells, and removal spells. By maintaining a strong defense with cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and eventually win through incremental advantage. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional synergy with enter-the-battlefield effects and provides added flexibility in longer games. The deck also utilizes card draw and card selection tools to ensure consistency in finding key pieces and answers to threats in the opponent's deck.

The main concept of this deck is to maximize devotion to green in order to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful green creatures and spells. It utilizes cards like Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, and Wolfwillow Haven to accelerate mana production, while cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll provide strong threats on the battlefield. Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures offer disruption and protection, while Storm the Festival helps to dig for more threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and powerful green creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the game and pressure the opponent. With cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Bonecrusher Giant, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence with cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents. Overall, the deck aims to establish dominance early on and maintain control throughout the match.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage and control the board. The key strategy is to use efficient and low-cost spells like Lightning Strike and Skewer the Critics to remove threats and chip away at the opponent's life total, while utilizing cards like Chandra, Dressed to Kill and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to provide additional reach and card advantage. The deck aims to be fast-paced and relentless in its attacks, putting pressure on the opponent to respond quickly or risk being overwhelmed.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to establish a fast and efficient board presence using low-cost creatures like Dreadhorde Arcanist, Favored Hoplite, and Monastery Swiftspear, supported by combat tricks and protection spells like Gods Willing and Homestead Courage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with the combination of creature aggression and instant-speed spells to control the battlefield and quickly close out the game. The inclusion of removal spells like Reckless Rage and defensive options like Sejiri Shelter solidify the deck's ability to adapt to different matchups and maintain pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence with efficient creatures like Bishop of Wings, Resplendent Angel, and Righteous Valkyrie. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of flying and lifelink creatures, supported by cards like Giada, Font of Hope and Skyclave Apparition for added value. The inclusion of Collected Company allows for explosive turns and potentially finding multiple threats at once. The deck aims to play aggressively while also maintaining some control elements with cards like Portable Hole and The Book of Exalted Deeds.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of flying Spirits and support creatures to quickly build a board presence and apply aggressive pressure on the opponent. Cards like Empyrean Eagle, Supreme Phantom, and Watcher of the Spheres boost the power of your Spirits, while cards like Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition provide disruption and removal. Collected Company allows you to quickly refill your board with creatures, maintaining pressure on your opponent. The deck aims to tempo out opponents by quickly deploying threats while disrupting their game plan.

Control the game through card advantage, removal, and countering opponent's spells, while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and The Wandering Emperor to generate value and protect yourself. Maintain flexibility with a mix of removal, counterspells, and card draw, providing answers to a variety of threats. Utilize lands like Castle Vantress and Glacial Fortress for additional control elements, while setting up for late-game dominance with Hullbreaker Horror and Torrential Gearhulk. Prioritize controlling the board and out-valuing your opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up quickly with mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, while utilizing Green devotion cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Old-Growth Troll to generate powerful threats on the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional utility and card advantage, making it a synergistic aggro deck focused on overwhelming opponents with early creature presence and maintaining a consistent mana base through Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through card advantage and disruption, using cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to limit the opponent's resources. It also utilizes board wipes like Supreme Verdict and targeted counterspells such as Dovin's Veto to maintain control of the battlefield. The inclusion of The Wandering Emperor provides additional card draw and protection. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells and utility lands to help deal with threats and stabilize the board.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing low-cost creatures like Favored Hoplite and Monastery Swiftspear combined with spells like Defiant Strike and Reckless Rage to deal damage rapidly. The deck also includes protection spells like Gods Willing and Sejiri Shelter to keep key creatures alive. Dreadhorde Arcanist helps to reuse spells and keep the pressure up. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with plenty of untapped lands for quick plays. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with early aggression and efficient spells.
